verdict.rationale: Coinbase publishes official CDP SDKs (client libraries for EVM/Solana wallets on GitHub), CLI, and MCP server, with docs explicitly targeting AI agents/agentic workflows (x402, Agentic Wallet CLI, Wallet MCP). This is strong first-party evidence directly relevant to AI-native developers building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration outside vendor docs and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s).
